summary: DHT Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing proactive design upgrades for two newbuildings (DHT Impala and DHT Gazelle) to improve trading eligibility and commercial flexibility. The upgrades are operational in nature, with delivery schedules and vessel substitutions mentioned (DHT Addax replacing DHT Gazelle during its upgrade). No financial terms, stakeholder actions, board recommendations, or advisors are provided. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
